'''Cipher Four''' was a codename of a [[Cipher Agent]] within [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he relayed to [[Minder Nine]] a report on the current situation on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]].
